entities.summary: Chung Chao-cheng was a Taiwanese novelist of Hakka descent born in the Hsinchu Prefecture during the Japanese rule period. Revered as the "Mother of Taiwanese Literature" in Taiwan, he is also frequently mentioned alongside Taiwanese writer Yeh Shih-tao, collectively known as "North Chung, South Yeh".
